title: Steering with the legs
subtitle: Seen from the front, and what your boots will show
steps: Turn your legs under a calm upper body.
Keep the skis flat and let them slide.

callouts.text: Small humps: the skis stay close to flat.
The turn comes from steering, so tilt alone shows very little.
Boot tilt can't show the steering. The gyro's turning rate may, but that is not validated yet.

footnote: Illustration of a typical shape, not a target. Tilt is relative, not degrees.
